name: Add a new plugin constant
query: Add a constant called MY_PLUGIN_API_URL that holds the REST API base URL for the plugin. Make sure it follows the boilerplate convention for constant placement.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run detect_wpboilerplate.mjs to confirm isWPBoilerplate: true
Step 2: Consult references/boot-flow.md to locate where constants are defined
Step 3: Open includes/Main.php and find the define_constants() method
Step 4: Add the new constant using the existing private define() guard: $this->define('MY_PLUGIN_API_URL', 'https://...')
Step 5: Append the new constant below the existing block — do not alter any existing define() calls
Step 6: Do NOT add the constant to the bootstrap file (wordpress-plugin-boilerplate.php)
Step 7: Do NOT use PHP's define() directly — use the private $this->define() wrapper
success_criteria: Constant is defined inside includes/Main.php::define_constants() only
Not added to the bootstrap file
Not defined in any other class or file
Existing constant definitions are not modified
